es: Replicar en un debate citando lo dicho, concediendo un punto y presentando una contrapropuesta clara.

teaching.en: Ana asked who would pay for the water, and that is a fair question.
teaching.es: Ana preguntó quién pagaría el agua, y es una pregunta razonable.
teaching.explanationEs: Reportas la pregunta y reconoces su valor antes de responder.

prompt.es: ¿Qué réplica concede primero y después contraargumenta?

choices.text: I concede that the path is dark; however, new lights will fix it.
The path is not dark, so you are wrong.
You are wrong, and lights are expensive.

feedback.es: Solo la réplica que empieza con I concede reconoce un punto válido y después responde con una solución.

hint.es: Busca la opción que empieza reconociendo algo de lo que dijo la otra persona.

prompt.es: Completa: «En lugar de cerrar el parque, sugiero poner más luces.»

feedback.es: Instead of + -ing descarta una opción y presenta la alternativa.

hint.es: Es la expresión de la clase que descarta una opción.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cómo responde la hablante a Tom.

choices.text: She refuses to discuss the noise.
She admits the problem but explains how to limit it.

origin.audio: Tom said the garden would be too noisy. I agree that noise is a concern, but the garden will close at nine, so nobody will hear it after that.

prompt.es: ¿Qué réplica cita lo dicho, concede un punto y contrapropone?

choices.text: Leo suggested building a car park, so he is wrong and that is all.
Leo suggested building a car park. However, that is a bad idea.
Leo suggested building a car park. I take his point; however, I would suggest a small garden too.

feedback.es: La réplica con I take his point reporta lo dicho, reconoce un punto y propone algo; las demás solo rechazan.

origin.text: Leo: «We should build a car park here.»

prompt.es: Ordena: «Acepto tu punto; sin embargo, el jardín cerrará temprano.»

feedback.es: I take your point concede y however abre la réplica antes del resto de la frase.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué propone la hablante en lugar de una puerta alta.

feedback.es: La hablante reconoce la pregunta y propone algo más sencillo: a simple lock.

origin.audio: Mia asked whether the garden would need a high gate. That is a fair question, but I would not build one; a simple lock would be enough.

prompt.es: Escribe un párrafo que responda a los tres vecinos: reporta, concede y contrapropone.

answer.text: Tom argued that the garden would bring too much noise. I concede that noise can be a problem, but the garden will close at nine, so the street will stay quiet after that. Ana asked who would pay for the water. That is a fair question, and my answer is simple: we could share the cost among the neighbours. Finally, Leo suggested that we build a car park instead. I take his point, because parking is a real problem. However, I would suggest a small garden and ten parking spaces. Instead of choosing one idea or the other, we could try both for six months. Would you be willing to vote on that plan next week?

feedback.es: El párrafo reporta cada intervención, concede un punto, responde con una contrapropuesta y cierra con una pregunta.
